title: List every user of the account in an Excel file

titleLocal.fra: Lister les utilisateurs du compte dans un fichier Excel

description: Finds every user of the account, converts the XML result into a Generate-Excel request with an XSLT and renders a one-sheet workbook. The smallest complete find-to-Excel job.

descriptionLocal.fra: Recherche tous les utilisateurs du compte, convertit le résultat XML en requête Generate-Excel avec une XSLT et génère un classeur d'une feuille.

tasks.name: data-user-find
tasks.description: Find every user of the current account, rendered as an XML attachment (xpath-functions vocabulary)

tasks.name: file-transformation-xslt
tasks.description: Turn the users XML into a Generate-Excel request (one header row, one row per user)

tasks.name: file-generation-xlsx
tasks.description: Render the workbook with the shipped template
